info.name: Ahlena App — Caregiver operations
info.description: Availability read, caregiver-owned earnings, medication tasks, help-request lifecycle, payout account, and caregiver-facing payout reads. State-changing requests require disposable fixtures.

item.name: Get caregiver availability
item.description: FamilyAccess. Schedule windows are caregiver-local and include availability status.

item.name: Get caregiver availability for a date
item.description: FamilyAccess. Date-specific declared availability minus active booking overlaps; timeZoneId is Africa/Cairo and intervals are UTC instants, advisory only (not a hold or expiry rule). shiftType accepts HomeVisit, EightHourShift, TwelveHourShift, TwentyFourHourShift, Hourly. 400 Caregivers.Availability.InvalidQuery for a missing or invalid date/shiftType; 404 Caregivers.NotFound. An inactive or manually unavailable caregiver answers 200 with an empty intervals array.

item.name: Get earnings summary
item.description: CaregiverAccess and self-only. Totals use completed bookings’ BaseCaregiverFee, not a payout ledger.

item.name: Get earnings transactions
item.description: CaregiverAccess and self-only. Page size is bounded by the API.

item.name: List medication tasks
item.description: CaregiverAccess; only tasks for an elderly person linked by Confirmed or InProgress booking are returned.

item.name: Skip medication task
item.description: Reason is required and must contain 1–500 non-whitespace characters.

item.name: Get payout account
item.description: CaregiverAccess and self-only. Returns the masked IBAN (**** plus last four); the full IBAN is never returned. 404 when no account was saved.

item.name: Update payout account
item.description: CaregiverAccess and self-only. Upserts and returns Pending with a masked IBAN. Bank code must be active; IBAN must be a SWIFT-registered format (country, length, BBAN, checksum). Stored as authenticated ciphertext plus last four only; missing key configuration fails closed with 503. State-changing: disposable fixture only.

item.name: Get payout summary
item.description: CaregiverAccess and self-only. unpaidAmount = eligible-unrecorded bookings (Completed + Paid, past the payout-policy delay, no Paid row; a Failed row does not clear the debt). transferredAmount = sum of Paid net amounts (Transferred is an alias of Paid; there is no Processing state). nextExpectedPayoutOnUtc is computed only with a Verified payout account, else null. No effective policy → 400 Finance.PayoutPolicy.Missing (fail closed).

item.name: List payouts
item.description: CaregiverAccess and self-only. status accepts Paid or Failed (any other value → 400); page ≥ 1, pageSize clamped 1–100, newest-recorded first. amount = gross (net always equals gross); bankNameArabic/bankNameEnglish resolved from the snapshotted bankCode (null when unknown); transferredOnUtc set only on Paid rows.

item.name: Get payout detail
item.description: CaregiverAccess and self-only. Same fields as the list item plus bookingItems (always one element: bookingId, caregiverAmount = gross, currency). Another caregiver's id → 404 Caregivers.Payouts.NotFound (no existence leak).

item.name: Get payment policy
item.description: CaregiverAccess. Admin-authored descriptionArabic/descriptionEnglish of the effective payout policy (null before descriptions existed or when no policy exists). requiresVerifiedBankAccount is always true; minimumPayoutAmount and expectedProcessingDays are honest nulls — no such rules exist.

item.name: List eligible care-record recipients
item.description: Names only; own Confirmed/InProgress or completed-within-30-days bookings. Permission is rechecked on every subsequent call.

item.name: List own-source care records for a dependent
item.description: Medical and companion caregivers; own-source only, for a dependent linked by the caregiver's own eligible booking.

item.name: Create caregiver-source care record
item.description: The dependentId is a selector only; booking scope is revalidated at write. The Idempotency-Key header is optional: leave caregiverCareRecordIdempotencyKey empty for the legacy behavior; the same trimmed key (1–128 printable ASCII, else 400 Families.CareRecords.IdempotencyKeyInvalid) with the same request replays the stored 201 body without a second record, and the same key with a different request is 409 Families.CareRecords.IdempotencyConflict. Replayed snapshots are retained for 7 days; cleanup is operational, not automatic. Mutation: approved disposable fixture only.

item.name: Update caregiver-source care record
item.description: Versioned update; stale expectedVersion returns 409. Approved disposable fixture only.

item.name: Delete caregiver-source care record
item.description: Caregiver own-source only; success 204. Mutation: approved disposable fixture only.
